title: Open Book Touch: open-source e-reader
summary: Open Book Touch is an open-source e-reader hardware project hosted on Crowd Supply, developed by Oddly Specific Objects. It provides a customizable, privacy-focused alternative to proprietary e-readers like Kindle or Kobo, allowing users full control over their reading device hardware and software.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source alternative to locked-down proprietary e-readers, enabling user freedom, repairability, and customization.
why_valuable: Empowers readers with hardware ownership, privacy, and the ability to modify their device for their specific needs.
